titulo_es: Compare impacts of an environmental measure

Åtgärden påverkar flera grupper.es: La medida puede afectar a varios grupos
Åtgärden påverkar flera grupper.en: The measure may affect several groups

texto: Explain uncertainty, data limits and impacts of a public measure. **Åtgärden påverkar flera grupper** means «The measure may affect several groups». Analyzes the scope and registration of the expression. Distinguish the data of the interpretation, check what evidence it holds and practice a precise paraphrase. Sequence 3 of 3: incorporates this expression and reviews the above.
